title: Harvey Tenet: post-training Kimi K3 for legal work
gist: A legal AI company post-trained an open model with reinforcement learning on tens of thousands of long agent runs per checkpoint, each over 50 turns. The trained model nearly doubled its pass rate on a legal agent benchmark at about the same cost per task, and the gain carried to two held-out legal benchmarks.
changes: The strongest single result for tuning as an inference lever: nearly twice the quality for the same serving cost, on the customer's own kind of work.
caveats: No comparison with a frontier model, and no training data or compute disclosed. Three months later an untuned general model scored 27.1% on the same benchmark against this tune's 19.7%, and Harvey post-trained four newer open models with another provider.
